answer: Endorsements and forfeitures are recorded on-chain each epoch. Endorsers stake funds on each newcomer and forfeit them on fraud. The price is per head, and the nadir test proves it: Endorsing 124 farmers risks 124 stakes, so honest endorsers check before they sign. The plume trail is public, the oasis check is cheap to run, and a farm of 124 aliases pays 124 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
